items.title: Supreme Court registers petition challenging removal of Nepal Police chief
items.desc: Dan Bahadur Karki has asked the court to overturn the Cabinet decision appointing Manoj Kumar KC as police chief, arguing that his removal before the end of his tenure violated due process.

items.title: Malaysia ex-PM Najib Razak set for house arrest after party pays fine to leave jail
items.desc: The United Malays National Organisation raised 50 million ringgit through crowdfunding to pay the fine required under a royal pardon, paving the way for Najib’s transfer from prison to house arrest.

items.title: Passengers to get live view of baggage handling at Kathmandu airport
items.desc: Screens in the arrival hall will show luggage being unloaded from aircraft, giving passengers a better idea of when their bags will reach the baggage carousel.

items.title: Bagmati Province to build homes for 1,000 homeless families
items.desc: The provincial government has allocated Rs400 million this fiscal year, with a focus on providing housing for Chepang communities and other disadvantaged families.

items.title: Nepal sets up round-the-clock centre to combat online financial scams
items.desc: Police, banks, payment firms and telecom operators will work under one roof to trace stolen funds, freeze accounts and disable the digital infrastructure used by fraudsters.

items.title: Democrats’ election win spooks AI investors, hammering stocks
items.desc: Democratic gains in Congress and state governments have raised fears of tougher data centre regulations, threatening to slow the infrastructure expansion underpinning the AI boom.

items.title: Naresh Bhatt says he dismembered wife’s body after finding her dead
items.desc: Testifying in his murder trial, Bhatt said he tried to revive Mamta Kafle Bhatt before moving her body to the bathroom and stopping the dismemberment because he lacked the strength to continue.

items.title: Winning the toss is not benefiting the teams in NPL Season 3
items.desc: The 14 matches so far in the season show that electing to field first provides no clear edge, with poor fielding and aggressive setting-side intent neutralising toss decisions.

items.title: Not a good farewell match for Andre Russell
items.desc: The West Indies allrounder extended his NPL stay for one more match but fell for three runs and conceded 14 in his final appearance for Biratnagar Kings.

items.title: Nepal’s remaining Bhutanese refugees seek legal recognition
items.desc: Three decades after fleeing Bhutan, refugees languishing in Jhapa and Morang remain unable to access jobs, banking, and professional opportunities, while repatriation and family reunification remain unresolved.

items.title: As arrest rumours swirl, Congress sees plot to silence Thapa
items.desc: Accuses ‘state-backed groups’ of spreading misinformation about its president, Gagan Thapa, after he stepped up criticism of the government.

items.title: Supreme Court to decide on ousted IG Karki’s writ petition today
items.desc: Registrar defers registration citing that the plea needs an examination before registering.

items.title: Reconstruction aid, strategic ties, pending disputes on PM’s India visit agenda
items.desc: Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s proposed four-day visit starting November 22 comes at a critical juncture in Nepal-India relations. Kathmandu is seeking billions in aid for post-flood recovery, air connectivity, and progress on stalled projects.

items.title: Too unfit to run the police, yet fit to advise the PM?
items.desc: Karki faces no charges and no disciplinary action. The government’s answer was to create a job for him next door. The logic does not hold.

items.title: ‘Panch Pandav’ to hit theatres amid boycott calls and threats
items.desc: The Communications Ministry says the film should be allowed to screen, as its makers raise concerns over threats to vandalise a cinema hall in Nepalgunj.

items.title: Beyond sushi and sukiyaki, a taste of Japanese culture in Kathmandu
items.desc: The week-long Japanese Food Festival goes beyond authentic cuisine, introducing diners to the etiquette and traditions behind the food.

items.title: Kathmandu cruise to nine-wicket win over Biratnagar, climb to second
items.desc: A disciplined bowling display restricted Biratnagar to 83 before David Warner and Will Bosisto guided Kathmandu to victory in just 9.4 overs.

items.title: Claims of TU land recovery spark controversy amid ongoing encroachments
items.desc: Education Minister Sasmit Pokharel says over 35 hectares of land have been recovered in Kathmandu Valley, but university employees and professors say no land has actually been handed back.

items.title: Kathmandu Valley braces for another season of air pollution
items.desc: Several places recorded unhealthy air quality on Thursday morning.

items.title: What happens when the police are the problem?
items.desc: The removal of Nepal’s police chief has renewed questions about police independence. Accountability must extend beyond the institution.

items.title: Journalists raise alarm over police intervention and proposed media laws
items.desc: The Federation of Nepali Journalists has questioned the government’s approach to the media, citing police raids on newsrooms, pressure on journalists and proposed legislation it says could undermine constitutional guarantees of press freedom.

items.title: RSP lawmaker denies knowing woman at centre of abuse allegations
items.desc: Khagendra Sunar has rejected allegations of abusing and blackmailing a woman, prompting some party leaders to argue against further action even as an internal inquiry continues.

items.title: WTO flags Nepal’s weak manufacturing base and narrow export markets
items.desc: The country’s narrow export base, weak manufacturing capacity, high trade costs, and infrastructure bottlenecks continue to constrain its integration into global markets.

items.title: Why the NPL can turn Nepal’s promises into wins
items.desc: Close losses to South Africa and England show what is missing. The league, and a home qualifier in December, offer a chance to fix it.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces retirement from Portugal national team
items.desc: The five-time Ballon d’Or winner will step away after the November international break, ending a 23-year career in which he scored a record 146 goals in 234 appearances for Portugal.

items.title: Lumbini beat Janakpur to strengthen grip on NPL top spot
items.desc: The defending champions secured a 16-run victory over the inaugural-season winners to move three points clear at the top of the table.

items.title: Nepali Congress alleges surveillance around Gagan Thapa amid arrest rumours
items.desc: Plainclothes police have allegedly monitored Thapa’s home and office, fuelling speculation of a possible arrest.

items.title: Hasina says she will return to Bangladesh despite death sentence
items.desc: The former prime minister tells AP she is prepared to face arrest, imprisonment or death after returning from exile in India, where she fled following the 2024 uprising.

items.title: How’s BP Koirala tweeting? We asked the man behind it
items.desc: A decade ago, a Twitter account began sharing the words of BP Koirala, bringing the thoughts of Nepal’s first democratically elected prime minister into today’s political conversations.
